title: Buildings and industry
description: Cut the fossil fuel burnt in buildings and in steel and cement plants: its CO₂, the methane leaked supplying it and its air pollution, whose cooling goes too.

cleanHeating.title: Clean heating
cleanHeating.description: Heat pumps and electric cooking replace gas and oil boilers: their CO₂ goes, the grid's CO₂ for running them comes.

cleanIndustry.title: Clean steel and cement
cleanIndustry.description: Steel made with hydrogen or scrap in electric furnaces, cement with less clinker and its CO₂ captured; the electricity they draw counts.
